descriptions.preferred: 'Harusame', whose name means "spring rain," is best known for its fall coloration, when the red color is dusted with yellowish brown markings of the sunago fu (sand-dusted) type of variegation. Most of the year, the Corvallis a character. In some years, there have been only two leaves on the whole tree so variegated. The fiveor seven-lobed leaves are of the Palmatum Group, with length and width about 5 cm. The lobes are lanceolate-ovate, divided two-thirds or more to the center, and coarsely toothed. The petioles are about 4 cm long. This plant makes an upright, bushy, small tree. It does not reach much more than 3 m tall and wide, and that after a considerable age. The name is sometimes misspelled

sources.title: 春雨Acer Palmatum 'Harusame'
sources.description: 小叶品种，原产于日本、中国和韩国，以其披针形 的卵形叶子、带齿的叶柄和丰富的秋天色彩而闻 名。在春天，鲜红的叶子展开并慢慢成熟为黄绿色， 可能会有少数的白色杂色叶子，然后在夏天变成浅 绿色，秋天变成红色和黄棕色调。成年树高大约为 3 米左右，非常耐寒。于 1822 年在 Sekihin Binran 上被首次提及，有时候会错误拼写成 Harusume 或 Marusame。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Harusame' 意为“春雨”，最著名的是其秋色：红色叶面上洒布着黄褐色的 sunago fu（砂撒斑）型斑纹。全年大部分时间里，这种斑锦并不明显，有些年份整株树上甚至只有两片叶子出现如此斑纹。叶片属 Palmatum Group，5 裂或 7 裂，长宽约 5 厘米。裂片为披针状卵形，分裂达叶片中心的三分之二以上，边缘具粗锯齿。叶柄长约 4 厘米。植株形成直立、丛生的小乔木，需相当年数后才不超过约 3 米高、3 米宽。其名称有时被误写为 'Harasume' 或 'Marusame'。
